subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` plus an optional `parentPeer` inbound-envelope SDK parameter as the public shape for Google Chat DM thread sessions?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but the new config key and SDK helper parameter become public contracts and overlap existing Google Chat thread-session PRs, so automation cannot choose the lasting API/product direction.

options.title: Accept after rebase, baselines, and proof
options.body: Keep the default-off `threadSessions` shape, require generated baseline updates and current-head Google Chat proof, then review the clean rebased branch.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-local
options.body: Reject or narrow the public SDK helper change and make Google Chat own the route-parent plumbing without expanding the SDK surface.

options.title: Consolidate thread-session work
options.body: Pause this PR and settle one canonical Google Chat thread plan across the competing PRs and broader issue.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase, baselines, and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off `threadSessions` shape, require generated baseline updates and current-head Google Chat proof, then review the clean rebased branch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across routing, Plugin SDK, and Google Chat thread/reply behavior.
